name: Proffessor v3
summary: Proffessor v3 is a trend-following expert advisor that uses moving average crossovers combined with momentum indicators to identify and trade trend direction. The EA enters positions when fast and slow moving averages cross and momentum confirms the trend, applying trailing stops for trade management. It is designed for medium-term trading on major currency pairs.
summary_zh: Proffessor v3是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用均线交叉结合动量指标来识别和跟随趋势方向交易。当快慢均线交叉且动量确认趋势时开仓，并使用追踪止损管理仓位，适用于主流货币对的中线交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于双均线交叉系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求均线交叉信号与动量指标（如MACD或RSI）方向一致，形成双重确认机制以减少假信号。出场条件包括追踪止损触发、反向均线交叉信号出现或固定止损止盈达到。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式，允许用户自定义风险参数。资金管理方面，EA提供止损设置来控制单笔亏损，但缺乏整体账户风险控制和最大回撤限制功能。总体而言，策略逻辑较为经典，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a dual moving average crossover system, using golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require that the MA crossover signal aligns with momentum indicators (such as MACD or RSI), creating a dual confirmation mechanism to reduce false signals. Exit conditions include trailing stop activation, opposite MA crossover signal appearance, or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels being reached. Position sizing uses fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing, allowing users to customize risk parameters. Money management includes stop-loss settings to control per-trade losses, but lacks overall account risk control and maximum drawdown limits. Overall, the strategy logic is classic and suitable for trending markets, but may generate frequent false-signal losses in ranging conditions.
pros: 双确认机制（均线交叉+动量确认）减少了假信号
追踪止损功能可以锁定浮盈，让利润奔跑
参数可调性强，用户可以根据不同市场环境优化设置
策略逻辑经典易懂，便于理解和回测验证
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism (MA crossover + momentum) reduces false signals
Trailing stop feature locks in floating profits and lets winners run
Highly configurable parameters allow optimization for different market conditions
Classic strategy logic is easy to understand and backtest
cons: 在震荡市中均线交叉会产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏账户级别的资金管理控制，如最大回撤限制
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损可能过早被触发
cons_en: MA crossovers generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks account-level money management controls such as maximum drawdown limits
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Missing spread filter, stop-losses may be triggered prematurely in high-spread environments
improvements: 添加ADX或波动率过滤来避免在震荡市中交易
增加新K线检查机制防止同根K线重复开仓
加入账户级别的风险控制，如最大回撤限制和每日最大亏损限制
添加点差和滑点过滤以改善入场质量
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to avoid trading in ranging markets
Implement new bar check to prevent duplicate position opening on the same bar
Add account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown and daily loss limits
Add spread and slippage filters to improve entry quality

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓
没有账户级最大回撤控制
震荡行情下频繁假信号可能造成连续亏损
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause duplicate positions on the same bar
Frequent false signals in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility changes
